turns.user_message: We're mostly into live music and good food
turns.agent_response:
You've come to the right place because live music is essentially our heartbeat. The Wolf Den is the spot you need to see—it is an intimate venue right in the middle of the Casino of the Earth where you can catch national acts for free. Since it is Sunday, there is typically a show at 8:00 PM, and the energy in there is fantastic because you are so close to the performers. 

A bit of an insider tip: the Wolf Den was designed so there isn't a bad seat in the house, but since it is free, the line starts early for popular acts. For dinner, Michael Jordan's Steak House is just a short walk away if you want something upscale, or Comix Roadhouse offers a great menu with a more casual, high-energy atmosphere right near the action. What kind of music do you two usually enjoy?
